Loop replays after ~10s.
critical_code_review_comments: .chat-glass now correctly uses hsl(var(--card))/hsl(var(--border)) with [data-theme='dark'] override — clean theme-aware pattern.

ChatWidget.jsx no longer contains bg-black/*, text-white, border-white/10, bg-white/* hardcoded classes; all replaced with semantic tokens (bg-muted, text-foreground, border-border, text-muted-foreground, bg-background).

HeroDemo.jsx is a self-contained loop component — fine, but the widget panel inside HeroDemo intentionally uses hardcoded dark colours (bg-neutral-950, border-white/10) because it mimics the assistant preview regardless of page theme. This is deliberate and looks correct in both light and dark landing.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: .chat-glass was hardcoded to a dark translucent background (bg-black/60 or similar) plus ChatWidget.jsx used bg-black/*, text-white, border-white/10 classes — in light mode the surrounding page turned white but the widget stayed dark AND the light-themed foreground tokens (dark text) rendered against still-dark bleeding backgrounds inside sections that used semantic classes. Fix: (a) .chat-glass now maps to hsl(var(--card))/hsl(var(--border)) so it inherits the theme; a [data-theme='dark'] .chat-glass override restores the translucent dark glass look for dark mode. (b) All hardcoded color classes inside ChatWidget.jsx were swapped for semantic tokens (text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-muted, bg-background) — content now stays readable under both themes. Verified: light panel is rgb(250,250,250)/rgb(20,20,20), dark panel is rgba(10,10,10,0.85)/rgb(250,250,250), assistant/user bubbles both use text-foreground on muted/primary bgs — readable in both themes.
